Umuyobozi w’ubwato ategetswe:
A boat driver must:

isuku igihe cyose atwaye ubwato; a) Be clean, wear tidy clothes including clean shoes at all

b) Kugira imyitwarire myiza n’ikinyabupfura no kubaha
abagenzi, abayobozi b’ayandi mato, cyangwa abayobozi b) Behave in an orderly manner and with civility and

c) Kutanywera itabi cyangwa ibisa naryo mu bwato bwaba driver of another boat or authorized officer;
butwaye abagenzi cyangwa butabatwaye; c) Not smoke any kind of tobacco while in the boat, whether

Umuyobozi w’ubwato ntiyemerewe kubutwara iyo:
The driver of boat must not drive the boat if:

Ingingo ya 4: Kutangiza ibigize Ubwato
Article 4: /ot to interfere with equipment of, or damage, a
boat
Umuyobozi w’ubwato ntiyemerewe:
The driver of a boat is not allowed:
a) Ntampamvu zifatika guhindura igice cyangwa ibice bigize
ubwato; a) without reasonable excuse, to interfere with any equipment
attached to, or forming part of, the boat; or
b) Kwangiza abigendereye ubwato cyangwa ibice bibugize.
b) Willfully damage any part of the boat.
